facts.business: Grand Foundry Limited is a fibre infrastructure company that creates, acquires, leases, operates and monetises fibre networks for telecom operators, ISPs, enterprises and government programmes.

auditor.name: M/s Agarwal & Saxena, Chartered Accountants (Firm Registration No. 002405C)

key_risks: Dependence on telecom operator capex cycles and 5G rollout pace
Right of Way (RoW) approval delays and regulatory changes
Competition from other neutral-host fibre providers and operator-owned networks
Capital intensity of fibre deployment with long payback periods
Rural and BharatNet project execution risks including funding and maintenance
facts.related_party_note: There were no materially significant transactions with related parties, pecuniary transactions or relationship between the Company and its Directors during the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 that may have potential conflict with the interest of the Company at large. The transactions with the related parties, as per the requirements of the Accounting Standard (AS) 18, are disclosed in the Notes on Accounts, forming part of the Annual Report.
